help:
Choose your spawn!
To use, simply use your scrollwheel or arrow keys to cycle through available spawnpoints. Press right mouse button (mouse2) to automatically select the spawnpoint closest to Checkpoint #1.
You can also use: - "/spawnchoice #" to warp to a specific spawnpoint. - "/spawnchoice +#" or "/spawnchoice -#" to move relative to your current spawn.
Your selected spawnpoint is automatically saved to your computer (spawns.xml) for each map, so it will remember your preference next time you play the map!
SpawnChoice can only be used during the pre-race grid countdown. It is disabled on maps that have it explicitly disabled, have only 1 spawnpoint, or do not have ghostmode enabled.
To disable it on your map, place a setting inside your map's meta.xml named "#spawnchoice" with a value of "[ 'false' ]".
